caption_L1: This bar diagram is labeled Construction costs of buildings in Ontario , Canada in 2019 , by select building type (in Canadian dollars per square meter). A categorical scale starting with Enclosed mall and ending with Warehouse can be seen on the x-axis, marked building type. A linear scale from 0 to 5,000 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Minimum.
caption_L2L3: Healthcare is the highest cost per square meter. Warehouses were the lowest cost. There isn’t much of a cost difference between building offices that have 5-10 floors, than building an office that has 10-20 floors.
